reading.passage: Every year on the fifth of December, millions of people around the world celebrate International Volunteer Day. Some clean up parks, others donate blood or visit the elderly, and many simply help neighbours they have never met. These small actions remind us that anyone can make a difference.
reading.passageCn: 每年12月5日,世界各地数百万人庆祝国际志愿者日。有人清理公园,有人献血或探望老人,还有许多人只是帮助素未谋面的邻居。这些小小的行动提醒我们:人人都能带来改变。

lines.text: I want to start volunteering, but I don't know where to begin.
lines.cn: 我想做志愿者,可不知从哪儿开始。

lines.text: Think about what you really care about first.
lines.cn: 先想想你真正在意什么。

lines.text: I love animals, so maybe I'll help at the shelter.
lines.cn: 我喜欢动物,也许我会去收容所帮忙。

lines.text: Great. I'll ask whether they need helpers this weekend.
lines.cn: 太好了。我去问问他们这周末是否需要帮手。

lines.text: How was your visit to the care home today?
lines.cn: 你今天去敬老院怎么样?

lines.text: Lovely. An old man told me how he had been a teacher for forty years.
lines.cn: 很愉快。一位老人给我讲他当了四十年老师。

lines.text: Yes, he asked whether I could come back next week.
lines.cn: 喜欢,他问我下周能不能再来。
